verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for Nitrokey because it ships software (the nitropy CLI, firmware and an SDK), so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents telemetry, usage tracking or any way to turn them off. The open-source firmware and licensing items are adjacent and do not show an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
